name: Xend Finance
tagline: DeFi platform for African credit unions and cooperatives.
description: Xend Finance is a decentralized finance (DeFi) platform, backed by Binance Labs and Google for Startups, that lets credit unions and cooperatives channel member savings into stablecoin-denominated yield products. Registered as Xend Tech Limited (Enugu, Nigeria), the company has since expanded into Asset Chain, an EVM-compatible Layer-1 blockchain for real-world asset tokenization.
